about: Texturizer's tools for agents (through Agent Link): name, what it does, its arguments as JSON Schema, its group, whether it changes the document.

texture_prepare.description: A body made ready for a surface texture by BumpMesh: an STL written face by face from one mesh of the whole part, and a mask file of the triangles of faces (names or queries) — mode include (texture only them: a grip) or exclude (all but them: keep a mating face plain). Answers the bumpmesh_texture_file call to make with it, then how to check the result against the body.
texture_prepare.source: Written for Agent Link for FreeCAD's draft tools; moved to Texturizer 14 Nov 2026

texture_check.description: Check a textured STL against the body it was made from, face by face: on each face the texture was for, the share of points moved and how deep (p95, out, into); leaked — faces meant to stay plain that moved (a mating face, a datum); bare — faces meant for texture that barely moved; and whether the mesh is closed. path: the textured STL; mask: texture_prepare's -mask.json (found beside it by name); tolerance as texture_prepare used. verdict ok or check. Changes nothing.

flat.description: mm a point may move and count as unmoved (0.01).

texture_check.source: Written for Agent Link for FreeCAD's draft tools; moved to Texturizer 14 Nov 2026
